topography.project_purpose: This brief describes the observed EVM deployment and audit surface for Liquity. It intentionally limits the description to receipted repository and on-chain evidence instead of inferring a business model.
topography.relationship_narrative: The pinned logic-topography run contains 65 contract row(s) across arbitrum, avalanche, base, berachain, ethereum, hyperliquid, optimism, scroll, sonic, swellchain. Structural roles: 38 core, 18 supporting, 9 unclassified. No upgradeable pattern was identified in these rows.
